text:
Clara: FYI I got a support ticket saying our Optimize toolkit page has mixed references to `quant_profile_latest` and `quantProfileLatest` and the Node snippet still shows the pre-async streaming usage. I opened a small PR to harmonize keys and update examples: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5033
Ibrahim: Good catch. Can you enumerate the files you touched so we can do a quick grep for similar patterns?
Clara: Sure: /optimize/quant/profiles.md, /examples/snippets/node/streaming-old.md, and /optimize/batching/cache.md. The PR replaces the Node streaming example and normalizes YAML keys to `quant_profile: quant_profile_v2025`.
Jo: Did you add a short migration blurb? Customers search old key names and get confused.
Clara: Yep  one-line top-of-page note: "Old keys (quant_profile_latest, quantProfileLatest) will continue to resolve but please use quant_profile: quant_profile_v2025." Also added a tiny example showing per-route batch overrides.
Felix: Can we add a docs smoke-check job that greps for camelCase keys in YAML (e.g., quantProfileLatest) and posts a warn-only comment? I can add the GH Action.
Ibrahim: Also add a test that parses our YAML snippets to ensure keys are valid schema fields. Warn-only for now so it doesn't block small fixes.
Jo: For Node snippet, make sure to recommend Node 18+ for `for await` and show the non-streaming `generate` example too. Many users copy-paste the simpler option.
Clara: Done: Node streaming uses `for await (const chunk of client.responses.stream({ model: 'rwr/small' }))` and non-streaming example uses `client.generate(...)`. I included a short callout about Node 18+.
Felix: I'll push a tiny GH Action on the PR branch that runs a grep and yaml-parse for changed files. It will comment with findings.
DocsBot: Automated note: PR 5033 created by Clara; reviewers requested: Ibrahim, Jo, Felix. Docs CI: link-checker queued.
Ibrahim: I'll run a repo-wide grep for `quantProfileLatest` and `quant_profile_latest` and post results here after lunch.
Jo: Thanks  once grep hits are addressed we can merge. Small ask: add an entry to the changelog under "docs" so customers searching old keys see the note.
Clara: Will add changelog line and ping reviewers. Target merge by Tuesday.
Felix: WIll post the GH Action link shortly.
